name: room-reserve
description: RoomReserve (SmartSpace) - ระบบบริหารจัดการจองห้องประชุมและทรัพยากรส่วนกลาง

scripts.seed: node -e "const {Pool}=require('pg');const fs=require('fs');if(fs.existsSync('.env')&&typeof process.loadEnvFile==='function'){process.loadEnvFile('.env');}const p=new Pool({database:process.env.DB_NAME||process.env.PGDATABASE||'roomreserve_db',user:process.env.DB_USER||process.env.PGUSER||'postgres',password:process.env.DB_PASSWORD||process.env.PGPASSWORD||'postgres',host:process.env.DB_HOST||'localhost',port:Number(process.env.DB_PORT||5432)});p.query(fs.readFileSync('database/seed.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Seed data inserted successfully from database/seed.sql');p.end();}).catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);});"
